scenes.title: General Settings offers an editable Daemon name row

steps.caption: Open General Settings from the Settings menu
General Settings lists a Daemon name row
Move from worktree base directory to poll interval

expect.text: machine hostname; restart daemon to apply
expect.label: unset daemon name defaults to the machine hostname

steps.caption: The unset daemon name shows the machine hostname default

scenes.title: a custom daemon name is typed into the row editor

steps.caption: Press [enter] to edit the daemon name
The editor explains the blank-to-reset behaviour
Type the custom daemon name studio-mini
The typed name is in the editor
The editor carries the restart guidance

scenes.title: saving persists the custom daemon name with restart guidance

steps.caption: Press [enter] to save the daemon name
The saved daemon name is shown on the row

expect.text: Daemon name: studio-mini (restart daemon to apply)
expect.label: saved daemon name with restart guidance

steps.caption: The row shows the custom name and that a restart applies it
